# snomed-rust

> SNOMED CT tooling for Rust: RF2 release file parsing, SCTID validation, an
> in-memory snapshot store with hierarchy queries, ECL (Expression
> Constraint Language), FHIR terminology building blocks, OWL axiom
> parsing, and EL-profile subsumption classification with necessary normal
> form generation. Nine published crates, zero external dependencies.

Independent community project, not affiliated with, endorsed by, or
certified by SNOMED International. Ships no SNOMED CT content — release
files are licensed material obtained under your own affiliate license.
SNOMED®, SNOMED CT®, and IHTSDO® are registered trademarks of International
Health Terminology Standards Development Organisation (IHTSDO). Use of the
trademarks does not constitute endorsement of this product by IHTSDO.

This is the website-appropriate copy of `llms.txt`: this site is a single
landing page, so links below resolve on GitHub rather than this domain,
except the homepage itself. The source-of-truth version, with repo-relative
links, lives at the project repository's own
[llms.txt](https://github.com/snomed-rust/snomed-rust/blob/main/llms.txt)
(see `spec/llms-json-and-llms-txt/index.md`).

- [README.md](https://github.com/snomed-rust/snomed-rust/blob/main/README.md): project overview, workspace layout, quickstart
- [INSTALL.md](https://github.com/snomed-rust/snomed-rust/blob/main/INSTALL.md): install and run
- [index.md](https://github.com/snomed-rust/snomed-rust/blob/main/index.md): documentation map — which layer answers which question
- [docs/tutorial.md](https://github.com/snomed-rust/snomed-rust/blob/main/docs/tutorial.md): guided, runnable, six-step walkthrough
- [snomed-rust.github.io](https://snomed-rust.github.io/): project homepage (this site)

## Specification (normative single source of truth)

- [spec/README.md](https://github.com/snomed-rust/snomed-rust/blob/main/spec/README.md): index of every spec and project policy
- [spec/01-overview.md](https://github.com/snomed-rust/snomed-rust/blob/main/spec/01-overview.md): RF2 goals, terminology, scope
- [spec/04-sctid.md](https://github.com/snomed-rust/snomed-rust/blob/main/spec/04-sctid.md): SCTID structure, partitions, Verhoeff check digit
- [spec/09-versioning.md](https://github.com/snomed-rust/snomed-rust/blob/main/spec/09-versioning.md): effectiveTime, active, moduleId, snapshot semantics
- [spec/10-ecl.md](https://github.com/snomed-rust/snomed-rust/blob/main/spec/10-ecl.md): Expression Constraint Language grammar and every ECL rule number
- [spec/11-fhir.md](https://github.com/snomed-rust/snomed-rust/blob/main/spec/11-fhir.md): FHIR `$lookup`/`$subsumes`/`$expand`
- [spec/12-owl.md](https://github.com/snomed-rust/snomed-rust/blob/main/spec/12-owl.md): OWL 2 functional-syntax subset used in the OWL Expression refset
- [spec/13-classification.md](https://github.com/snomed-rust/snomed-rust/blob/main/spec/13-classification.md): EL-profile subsumption classification
- [spec/14-necessary-normal-form.md](https://github.com/snomed-rust/snomed-rust/blob/main/spec/14-necessary-normal-form.md): necessary normal form (RF2 relationship) generation

## Crates

- [crates/snomed](https://github.com/snomed-rust/snomed-rust/blob/main/crates/snomed/README.md): facade crate — re-exports everything, `prelude`, end-to-end tests
- [crates/snomed-core](https://github.com/snomed-rust/snomed-rust/blob/main/crates/snomed-core/README.md): SCTID, `EffectiveTime`, component structs, well-known constants (no dependencies beyond std)
- [crates/snomed-rf2](https://github.com/snomed-rust/snomed-rust/blob/main/crates/snomed-rf2/README.md): file naming, streaming reader, refset member types
- [crates/snomed-store](https://github.com/snomed-rust/snomed-rust/blob/main/crates/snomed-store/README.md): snapshot builder, IS-A hierarchy, subsumption, full version history
- [crates/snomed-ecl](https://github.com/snomed-rust/snomed-rust/blob/main/crates/snomed-ecl/README.md): Expression Constraint Language lexer, parser, evaluator
- [crates/snomed-fhir](https://github.com/snomed-rust/snomed-rust/blob/main/crates/snomed-fhir/README.md): FHIR terminology service building blocks
- [crates/snomed-owl](https://github.com/snomed-rust/snomed-rust/blob/main/crates/snomed-owl/README.md): OWL 2 functional-syntax parser
- [crates/snomed-classify](https://github.com/snomed-rust/snomed-rust/blob/main/crates/snomed-classify/README.md): EL subsumption classifier, necessary normal form generation
- [crates/snomed-cli](https://github.com/snomed-rust/snomed-rust/blob/main/crates/snomed-cli/README.md): `snomed-cli` binary — `sctid`, `load`, `lookup`, `ecl`, `export`, `validate`, `classify`, `nnf`

## Project policies

- [spec/rust-msrv-n-minus-2/index.md](https://github.com/snomed-rust/snomed-rust/blob/main/spec/rust-msrv-n-minus-2/index.md): Minimum Supported Rust Version, current stable minus two
- [spec/rust-no-unsafe/index.md](https://github.com/snomed-rust/snomed-rust/blob/main/spec/rust-no-unsafe/index.md): no `unsafe` anywhere, `#![forbid(unsafe_code)]` at every crate root
- [spec/rust-api-stability.md](https://github.com/snomed-rust/snomed-rust/blob/main/spec/rust-api-stability.md): which public enums are `#[non_exhaustive]`, and why the ASTs are not
- [spec/rust-fuzz.md](https://github.com/snomed-rust/snomed-rust/blob/main/spec/rust-fuzz.md): fuzz targets, the no-panic invariant, seed corpora
- [spec/rust-bench.md](https://github.com/snomed-rust/snomed-rust/blob/main/spec/rust-bench.md): criterion benchmarks — what is measured and how
- [spec/docs-budget-and-links/index.md](https://github.com/snomed-rust/snomed-rust/blob/main/spec/docs-budget-and-links/index.md): 40 KB per-document budget, link integrity
- [spec/professionalization/index.md](https://github.com/snomed-rust/snomed-rust/blob/main/spec/professionalization/index.md): verified plans, accurate special files, CI-backed claims, trademark notice presence
- [spec/llms-json-and-llms-txt/index.md](https://github.com/snomed-rust/snomed-rust/blob/main/spec/llms-json-and-llms-txt/index.md): this file and `llms.json` — purpose, size budget, and link-target rule

## Process

- [plan.md](https://github.com/snomed-rust/snomed-rust/blob/main/plan.md): roadmap by phase, with the *why* behind non-obvious decisions
- [tasks.md](https://github.com/snomed-rust/snomed-rust/blob/main/tasks.md): execution checklist, more granular than `plan.md`
- [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/snomed-rust/snomed-rust/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): what changed per published release
- [.claude/skills/snomed-skill/SKILL.md](https://github.com/snomed-rust/snomed-rust/blob/main/.claude/skills/snomed-skill/SKILL.md): Claude Code skill for everyday SNOMED CT tasks (CLI, library, ECL)
- [.claude/skills/snomed-rust-maintainer-skill/SKILL.md](https://github.com/snomed-rust/snomed-rust/blob/main/.claude/skills/snomed-rust-maintainer-skill/SKILL.md): Claude Code skill for changing this repository's own code
